nguon.ten: VOA Learning English, Let’s Learn English Lesson 50: Back to School
nguon.giayPhep: Phạm vi công cộng: nội dung do VOA Learning English làm, được đăng lại khi ghi nguồn. Đoạn trích khoảng 1 phút. Truy cập ngày 25/11/2026.

dienTu.cau: Georgetown is the oldest Catholic and Jesuit university ____ .
The Jesuits are known worldwide for their ____ .
Taylor has been writing and re-writing the report ____ .
Sarah has been studying this topic ____ .

tracNghiem.cau: Why is Anna at Georgetown University?
luaChon: She has decided to study again.
She has a job as a professor there.
She is showing the school to her friends.

tracNghiem.cau: Is Anna late when she arrives?
luaChon: Yes, she is a little late.

tracNghiem.cau: Why does Sarah tell Anna not to worry?
luaChon: The report is not due today.
The professor has not arrived yet.
Sarah has saved a seat for her.

tracNghiem.cau: What does Anna ask Taylor for?
How does Anna feel at the end?
luaChon: upset that Taylor did not help her
worried that her report is not finished
glad that she found what she needed

cumTu.nghia: Suýt nữa thì rắc rối rồi.
